name: Interval Union Length Obfuscation
description: Replaces the binary domain $\{1, 2\}$ with two overlapping real intervals $\{[0, 1], [1, 2]\}$ and maps the pairwise difference constraint to a condition on the length of their union. This completely removes algebraic and graph coloring keywords while preserving the exact bipartite structure, forcing models to independently deduce that the geometric condition is equivalent to an inequality constraint.
